blocks.text:
**Armor Class.** 15 (natural armor)
**Hit Points.** 42 (12d8 – 12)
**Speed.** 50 ft.
**Saving Throws.** Wis +7, Int +5
**Skills.** Insight +7, Stealth +3
**Damage Resistances.** piercing, bludgeoning, slashing, from nonmagical attacks
**Damage Immunities.** cold
**Condition Immunities.** exhaustion
**Senses.** darkvision 60ft, passive Perception 14
**Languages.** Common
**Challenge.** 5 (1800 XP)
**Proficiency Bonus.** +3

**Pack Tactics.** The winter rabbit has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the winter rabbit's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

**Snow Camouflage.** The winter rabbit has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in snowy terrain.

**Keen Hearing and Smell.** The winter rabbit has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

**Multiattack.** The winter rabbit makes two Bite claw.

**Claw.** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 3 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If had adv then dmg is 4d6 + 3
